info.description: Token + Send Customer calls for the Shree Hari Website API External Client App (the same app and credentials as the Lead API). Fill client_id and client_secret in the collection variables, run '1. Get Access Token' first (it stores access_token), then any of the customer requests. Endpoint: POST {{instance_url}}/services/apexrest/shreehari/v1/customers.
